newsitem.title: CANADA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF PERNILLA WIBERG.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF PERNILLA WIBERG.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Pernilla Wiberg of Sweden, who won the women's World Cup super-G Sunday at Lake Louise:

Previous World Cup victories (13): Super-G -- Cortina 1994 (shared with Alenka Dovzan, Slovenia); Slalom -- Bad Kleinkircheim, Austria, 1991; Waterville Valley, New Hampshire, 1991; Narvik, Norway, 1992; Steamboat Springs, Colorado, 1992; Veysonnaz, Switzerland, 1993, '95; Morzine, France, 1994; Lenzerheide, Switzerland, 95; Semmering, Austria (I), 1995; Giant Slalom -- Lake Louise, Canada, 1991; Combined -- Sierra Nevada, Spain, 1994; Lenzerheide, Switzerland, 1995.

Other: Although she made a rock 'n' roll record "as a joke so I could do something different" in 1992, there is a more serious business side to Wiberg, too: she has 24 corporate sponsors. To keep some of that revenue, she lives in taxpayer-friendly Monte Carlo.
